Working remotely is a repetitively new concept with it growing in popularity in the 2020's.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

rmap <- readxl::read_excel(path = "/cloud/project/RMAP_Data_Descriptor_Data.xlsx")
new_rmap <- rmap |>
  rename(age = Please.share.the.following...Your.age.in.years..,
         remote_hours = On.average..what.amount.of.time.of.your.weekly.work.schedule.do.you.perform.remotely..in.the.office.......Remotely...Hours.,
         office_hours = On.average..what.amount.of.time.of.your.weekly.work.schedule.do.you.perform.remotely..in.the.office.......In.the.Office..Hours.,
         education = Please.share.the.following...Total.years.of.full.time.education..from.primary.school.to.higher.education...,
         experience = Please.share.the.following...Total.years.of.professional.working.life..count.part.time.work.as.a.fraction..e.g...0.5.for.half.time.work...,
         gender = What.is.your.gender.,
         industry = Please.indicate.the.industry.sector.you.work.in.,
         positive_score = Please.rate.the.following.statements.regarding.remote.work.on.a.scale.from..1..strongly.disagree.to..7..strongly.agree.......Remote.work.positively.impacts.my.personal.life..,
         negative_score = Please.rate.the.following.statements.regarding.remote.work.on.a.scale.from..1..strongly.disagree.to..7..strongly.agree.......Remote.work.negatively.impacts.my.career.advancement..promotion..recognition..skill.development...,
         work_life_bal = Please.rate.the.following.statements.regarding.remote.work.on.a.scale.from..1..strongly.disagree.to..7..strongly.agree.......I.find.it.difficult.to.maintain.a.healthy.work.life.balance.while.working.remotely..
         )
rmap <- NULL

new_rmap$experience <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", new_rmap$experience))
new_rmap$education <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", new_rmap$education))


new_rmap <- new_rmap |>
  filter(age > 18 & age < 100 & age > experience & remote_hours >= 1 & experience > 1)



ggplot(
  data = new_rmap,
  mapping = aes(
    x = experience,
    y = age,
    color = gender
  )
) +
  geom_point(position = "jitter")
```
